questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: How does an HTML parser handle script tags without `async` or `defer` encountered during parsing?

options.A: Parsing halts completely, script is fetched and executed immediately before HTML parsing resumes
options.B: Script is downloaded in background while HTML parsing continues unaffected
options.C: Script execution is postponed to idle time
options.D: Parser converts script to WebWorker thread

questions.explanation: Synchronous script tags block the HTML parser completely until the script is downloaded and executed.

questions.explanation:

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What severe security vulnerability occurs when raw, unsanitized user inputs are injected directly into HTML DOM via `innerHTML`?
questions.explanation: Inserting unescaped user string payloads into innerHTML allows attackers to inject malicious scripts (XSS).

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTTP security header configured in web servers restricts resource origin domains for scripts, styles, and images?
questions.explanation: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers mitigate XSS and data injection by specifying permitted content origins.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute on `<iframe>` sandboxes and restricts iframe privileges like form submission, script execution, or top-navigation?
questions.explanation: The 'sandbox' attribute enforces security restrictions on iframe content (e.g., sandbox="allow-scripts").

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: What is the difference between `display: none`, `visibility: hidden`, and `aria-hidden="true"` regarding screen readers?

options.A: `display: none` and `visibility: hidden` hide content from both DOM rendering and screen readers; `aria-hidden="true"` hides content only from screen readers while keeping visual rendering intact
options.C: `visibility: hidden` is read aloud by screen readers

questions.explanation: display:none/visibility:hidden hide visually and from accessibility tree; aria-hidden="true" hides exclusively from accessibility tree.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: When an HTML form contains invalid input controls upon user submission, what DOM event is fired on the invalid controls?
questions.explanation: The 'invalid' event fires on each invalid form element when form constraint validation fails upon submission.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which boolean attribute on <form> disables native browser HTML validation checks during submission?
questions.explanation: The 'novalidate' attribute on <form> bypasses standard browser field constraints during submission.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute on a submit button overrides the parent form's `action` attribute when clicked?
questions.explanation: 'formaction' overrides the default form action URI specifically for that submit button click.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute on a submit button overrides the parent form's `method` attribute?
questions.explanation: 'formmethod' overrides the default HTTP submission method (GET/POST) for that specific submit button.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the content model specification for the HTML5 `<template>` element?

options.A: Its contents are parsed into a DocumentFragment, stored in inert state, and not rendered in DOM until cloned via JavaScript
options.B: Its contents render immediately on screen with opacity 0.5
options.C: It operates as an external iframe

questions.explanation: <template> holds inert HTML markup parsed into a DocumentFragment that does not execute or render until instantiated by JS.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What happens when the browser parser encounters `<script>` inside `<head>` with `type="module"`?

options.A: It automatically behaves as if `defer` were specified, executing after DOM parsing completes
options.B: It blocks parsing synchronously like standard script
options.C: It fails to execute without async attribute
options.D: It executes in parallel with head styling

questions.explanation: ES modules (`type="module"`) are automatically deferred by default in modern browsers.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is Quirks Mode in browser HTML rendering?

options.A: A legacy emulation mode triggered by missing or invalid <!DOCTYPE> declarations
options.B: A special developer debugging mode in Chrome

questions.explanation: Missing doctype triggers Quirks Mode where browser emulates non-standard legacy browser layout bugs.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML5 tag is used to draw dynamic graphics, charts, or game animations via JavaScript rendering context?
questions.explanation: <canvas> provides a bitmap resolution-dependent surface renderable via 2D/WebGL JavaScript contexts.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the key technical difference between `<canvas>` and `<svg>` elements in HTML?

options.A: <canvas> is raster/bitmap pixel-based drawn via JS; <svg> is vector-based XML tree integrated into DOM

questions.explanation: Canvas is a pixel raster surface (immediate mode), while SVG is a DOM-accessible vector graph (retained mode).

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the primary function of Open Graph meta tags (e.g., `<meta property="og:title" content="...">`)?

options.A: To specify rich preview cards (title, image, description) when links are shared on social media platforms
options.B: To index site content faster on Google Search

questions.explanation: Open Graph protocol tags format rich snippets/preview cards for social media link shares.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: Which ARIA attribute creates a dynamic live region where content updates are announced immediately by screen readers without losing focus?
questions.explanation: aria-live="polite" or "assertive" instructs screen readers to announce dynamic content updates.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: What is the difference between `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-live="assertive"`?

options.A: `polite` waits until user is idle before announcing; `assertive` interrupts current speech immediately to announce updates

questions.explanation: 'polite' announces updates at natural speech pauses, whereas 'assertive' interrupts ongoing screen reader output immediately.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML attribute provides native drag-and-drop capabilities to HTML elements?
questions.explanation: The global 'draggable="true"' attribute enables native browser drag-and-drop interactions.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What security attribute combination on anchor tag `<a>` prevents target pages from performing reverse tabnabbing attacks when opening external links in new tabs?
questions.explanation: Combining target="_blank" with rel="noopener noreferrer" protects against parent window hijacking.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which iframe attribute value explicitly blocks embedded cross-origin content from executing scripts?

options.A: Omitting 'allow-scripts' from the sandbox attribute list

questions.explanation: If `sandbox` attribute is present on an iframe without 'allow-scripts', script execution is strictly disabled.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What does the browser Speculative Preloader do during HTML parsing?

options.A: Scans document ahead for external resources (images, scripts, CSS) and initiates network requests while main parser is blocked
options.B: Pre-renders entire page in background memory

questions.explanation: Speculative preloaders parse document raw streams ahead to fetch external files concurrently while main thread executes scripts.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Why must raw `<`, `>`, and `&` characters be escaped as entities in HTML body text and attributes?

options.A: To prevent browser parser ambiguity between actual markup tags/entities and plain text values

questions.explanation: Unescaped markup syntax characters cause parsing ambiguity or potential security injection bugs.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the behavior of input attribute `autofocus` on a page with multiple elements having `autofocus`?

options.A: The first element with autofocus in document order receives focus (or behavior is implementation-dependent)

questions.explanation: Only one element gets focus; browsers focus the first element in DOM tree containing the autofocus attribute.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which pseudoclass matches form controls whose values fulfill all validation constraint requirements?
questions.explanation: The CSS :valid pseudo-class targets form elements whose current value passes validation.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which pseudoclass matches form controls whose values fail validation constraints?
questions.explanation: The CSS :invalid pseudo-class targets form elements whose values fail constraint checks.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the consequence of leaving an unclosed `<table>` tag in an HTML document?

options.A: The browser attempts auto-closing at document end, but page layout below table may be corrupted or corrupted inside table tree

questions.explanation: Unclosed table tags disrupt browser parent-child tree construction, swallowing subsequent content into table scope.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What happens if both `async` and `defer` attributes are placed on a standard non-module `<script async defer src="...">` in modern browsers?

options.A: `async` takes precedence; if browser supports `async`, it acts asynchronously

questions.explanation: Modern browsers supporting `async` ignore `defer` when both attributes are present on legacy scripts.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which element is used inside `<video>` or `<audio>` to provide subtitle/caption track files (.vtt format)?
questions.explanation: The <track> tag provides WebVTT timed text tracks for subtitles or captions.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which method on HTML element allows programmatically checking if input satisfies constraints without submitting form?
questions.explanation: checkValidity() returns true if element matches validation constraints, firing 'invalid' event if false.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which method on HTML form control sets a custom validation error message string?
questions.explanation: setCustomValidity("msg") sets custom validation error text, rendering input invalid if string is non-empty.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: What ARIA role should be assigned to a custom clickable `<div>` functioning as a button to ensure screen reader accessibility?
questions.explanation: role="button" informs screen readers that a element acts as an interactive button control.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: If you assign `role="button"` to a `<div>`, what keyboard interaction must you manually implement via JavaScript?

options.A: Handling Enter and Space keypress events to trigger action

questions.explanation: Native <button> handles Enter/Space keys automatically; ARIA role="button" requires manual keydown event handlers for Space/Enter.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute on `` element allows browsers to defer image loading until user scrolls near it?
questions.explanation: loading="lazy" defers image downloading until it approaches the visible viewport threshold.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which image attributes `srcset` and `sizes` serve what primary optimization purpose?

options.A: Allowing browser to select optimal image resolution asset based on device pixel ratio and screen width

questions.explanation: srcset and sizes provide resolution switching capabilities for responsive image asset delivery.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the function of `<meta name="theme-color" content="#317EFB">` tag?

options.A: Sets background accent color of mobile browser toolbar / UI frame

questions.explanation: theme-color sets the surrounding browser interface/toolbar color on mobile OS browsers.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag links a Web Application Manifest JSON file to an HTML document for Progressive Web Apps (PWA)?
questions.explanation: <link rel="manifest"> links web app manifests specifying PWA icons, orientation, and launch modes.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is Document Fragment in JavaScript / DOM processing?

options.A: A lightweight, minimal document object that stores DOM nodes off-screen without triggering layout reflows when modified

questions.explanation: DocumentFragment holds off-screen DOM nodes, allowing batch mutations without triggering multiple page layout reflows.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is appropriate for wrapping fine print, disclaimer notes, or legal restrictions in HTML5?
questions.explanation: In HTML5, <small> represents side-comments and small print like legal or copyright text.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag represents machine-readable variable names or programmatic constants in text?
questions.explanation: The <var> tag defines variable names in mathematical expressions or programming contexts.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which element represents sample output from a computer program or system?
questions.explanation: The <samp> tag represents sample output from a computer program or terminal.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag represents result calculation output of user form actions in HTML5?
questions.explanation: The <output> tag represents the result of a calculation or script computation.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the danger of using `document.write()` in client-side scripts after page parsing has finished?

options.A: It completely overwrites existing document content, destroying current DOM and triggering security warnings
options.B: It throws an uncaught syntax error

questions.explanation: Calling document.write() post-load completely clears existing document DOM tree.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: How does Subresource Integrity (SRI) `<script src="..." integrity="sha384-...">` protect websites?

options.A: Verifies that fetched foreign CDN files match cryptographic hash, blocking compromised altered scripts

questions.explanation: SRI allows browsers to verify cryptographic hash signatures of CDN files, guarding against tampered resources.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute on form text input disables browser auto-complete history suggestions?
questions.explanation: autocomplete="off" instructs browsers not to display previously stored autocomplete suggestions for the field.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute controls spell-checking behavior for input fields or editable elements?
questions.explanation: The 'spellcheck' attribute enables or disables native browser spell checking on editable elements.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What does the global attribute `hidden` do when placed on an HTML element (`<div hidden>`)?

options.A: Indicates element is not yet or no longer relevant, applying CSS display: none by default
options.B: Sets opacity to 0 keeping layout space
options.D: Hides element from screen readers only

questions.explanation: The boolean 'hidden' attribute marks content as irrelevant; browsers hide it visually using display: none rule.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the effect of placing CSS `<link rel="stylesheet">` inside `<body>` instead of `<head>`?

options.A: Triggers Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) and render blocking during parsing

questions.explanation: Stylesheets in <body> block progressive rendering or cause Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC).

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: Which ARIA attribute explicitly establishes relationship where one element labels another element?
questions.explanation: aria-labelledby references element ID(s) containing text that serves as target element label.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Accessibility, ARIA basics, and alt text
questions.question: Which ARIA attribute connects an element to extended descriptive text (e.g. tooltip or help section)?
questions.explanation: aria-describedby references ID(s) of elements offering expanded descriptions or instructions.
